git_diff_explanation: In pom.xml, changes the org.activiti.build:activiti-parent version from 7.0.27 to 7.0.28.

Adds synchronized getFileNetAddresses(fileId) to TachyonFS. It connects to the master, returns null if not connected, obtains file blocks, collects unique NetAddress locations in a set, and returns them as a list; it can throw IOException.
Deletes AMBARI-666-CHANGES.txt, a branch changelog containing 633 removed lines.
Changes the build to copy testme.bat into the distribution directory and modifies the forever.bat Windows test script.

Adds the hbase.hregion.impl configuration key and refactors region flushing and storage classes including HRegion, HRegionServer, MemStore and StoreFlusher. It also changes region implementation selection and related tests.

Changes connection-pool lease request handling when per-route limits are reached and connections are stateful. Connect timeout is calculated as a long instead of an int, lease requests use deadlines, and pool implementations and tests are updated.
Adds oraclejdk11 to the Travis CI JDK matrix and changes maven_jacoco_version from 0.8.1 to 0.8.2.

Introduces schema-building functionality across metadata, table handling, and tests. TypeMapper adds a java2CQLDataType map from Java classes to Cassandra DataType values, including blob and boolean mappings; many related metadata classes change.
In JobEventRdbStorage.getOriginalTaskId, adds LIMIT 1 to the SQL query for original_task_id matching taskId and TASK_STAGING state. The query now requests at most one matching row.
NA: root commit has no parent diff available.
Reorganizes parent and module pom.xml files, including project coordinates, version inheritance, and dependency declarations.

Changes the join string helper and tests to accept more inputs, including iterable values, iterators, arrays, and supplied values. It adjusts separator and option handling while extending join behavior.
Adds a timestamp format yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS to default date formats accepted by date assertions. The change introduces newTimestampDateFormat and updates assertion documentation and tests.
Changes a README link for HttpRequest.java from raw2.github.com to raw.githubusercontent.com. The first-parent diff changes documentation only.
Updates Maven version values from 2.2.0-SNAPSHOT to 2.2.0 in the parent and module POM files as part of preparing a release.
Adds a test exercising actor exception behavior, including actor calls and assertions.
Changes indentation and file headers in Groovy logging code, including AsyncAppenderDelegate and its appendersByName map.

Reworks LoggingSystem initialization to avoid repeated initialization where possible. It changes logging initialization APIs, implementations and configuration resources, changes an EndpointMBeanExporter message from info to warn, and updates logging tests.

Changes behavior after an HTTP stream is closed: affected tests now expect IOException instead of IllegalStateException. HttpEngine closes bufferedRequestBody on disconnect, and Okio buffered sources and sinks gain close-state checks with corresponding tests.

First-parent diff refactors websocket code and logging, with SLF4J changes, and alters project/build files. It removes the old Travis Ant configuration and build.xml alongside broader code and test changes.
Adds a SPNEGO authentication test with BASIC fallback and updates test helpers. A getAuthHeader helper searches response headers for a prefix and fails if the expected header is not found.
Changes the version.org.jgroups property in pom.xml from 4.0.13.Final to 4.0.15.Final.
Renames parallelPostprocessing to parallelProcessing in configuration, accessors, and logging; the flag controls parallel processing of multiple groups. The diff also updates subproject references.
Reorganizes Maven POMs to use a common parent across modules, changing parent and module configuration and removing or moving repeated project metadata.
